name: sdwis-lcr-lead-action-level-next-period
description: At the first day of a community water system's next Lead and Copper Rule tap-sampling period, will that period's reported 90th-percentile lead concentration exceed the 15 µg/L action level?
split_description: Chronological on target SAMPLING_START_DATE, fixed before any model fitting: train 1995-01-01 to 2013-12-31; eval 2014-01-01 to 2018-12-31; holdout 2019-01-01 to 2023-12-31. Embargo: drop any row whose feature (prior) period SAMPLING_END_DATE is on or after the first day of the split it would fall into, so no feature window crosses a boundary. Rows are never shuffled; each system contributes at most one row per target period, and duplicate PB90 records for the same period are collapsed to the latest SAR_LAST_REPORTED_DATE before pairing. Boundaries and the agency floor are not to be revised after seeing any metric.
